claims.claim: Google Play store-listing A/B tests: one default graphics experiment (icon, feature graphic, screenshots; no text) OR up to five localized experiments (icon, feature graphic, screenshots and/or descriptions, up to five languages) at a time, with up to 2 variants. Global experiments were renamed default graphics experiments.
claims.raw_snippet: For each app, you can run one default graphics experiment or up to five localized experiments at the same time.

claims.claim: Google Play experiments allow up to 2 variants against the current store listing.
claims.raw_snippet: Number of variants : The number of experimental variants to test against the current store listing (you can choose up to 2 variants).

claims.claim: Google Play publication minimum: at least two screenshots across device types, minimum dimension 320px, maximum 3840px, long side at most twice the short side; up to 8 screenshots per device type.
claims.raw_snippet: You must provide a minimum of two screenshots across different device types to publish your store listing: JPEG or 24-bit PNG (no alpha) Minimum dimension: 320px Maximum dimension: 3840px

claims.claim: Google Play recommendation eligibility requires at least four screenshots at minimum 1080px, 16:9 landscape (1920x1080) or 9:16 portrait (1080x1920). This is not the publication minimum.
claims.raw_snippet: For apps, you must provide at least four screenshots with minimum 1080px resolution. These should be 16:9 for landscape (minimum 1920x1080px) screenshots and 9:16 for portrait screenshots (minimum 1080x1920px).

claims.claim: Google Play requires a feature graphic to publish a store listing: 1024x500px, JPEG or 24-bit PNG with no alpha.

claims.claim: Google Play bans text suggesting store performance, ranking, accolades, testimonials, or price/promotional information, naming Best, #1, Top, New, Free, Discount, Sale, Million Downloads, plus call-to-actions; the ban covers descriptions, screenshots and the feature graphic, not only the title.
claims.raw_snippet: do not use words like “Best,” “#1,” “Top,” “New,” “Free,” “Discount,” “Sale,” or “Million Downloads.”
